urls.title: Competitor page URLs
urls.description: One to 50 public HTTPS page URLs as strings. Duplicate URLs are captured once. The Actor does not crawl beyond the exact URLs you supply.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages to inspect
maxPages.description: Hard cap per run after deduplication. Successful captures count as results even if the text is unchanged.

includeText.title: Include captured source text
includeText.description: Keep enabled if you want to pass results back as comparison baselines on the next run. Captures retain at most 24,000 characters.

previousResults.title: Earlier successful results (optional)
previousResults.description: Paste captured rows from an earlier run, including text, requestedUrl, url and capturedAt. Filter out failed rows. No cross-run storage is read automatically.
